positions.name: [Banco de Talentos] Delivery AI Engineering Intern, Brazil - X Delivery
positions.posting_name: [Banco de Talentos] Delivery AI Engineering Intern, Brazil - X Delivery
positions.job_description: You will work alongside top-tier consulting teams from around the world, contributing to innovative and cutting-edge international projects. This is a unified Engineering Internship, where candidates are assessed across technical tracks, including Data Engineering and Software Engineering. In your day-to-day, you will: Collaborate with consulting teams to solve complex and diverse technological challenges Apply engineering best practices across data and/or software development contexts Work at the frontier of AI and technology, contributing to projects that shape how leading organizations operate globally Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in a technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or related) — expected graduation between December 2027 and July 2029 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English Strong programming skills in one or more languages (e.g., Python, SQL, Java, JavaScript, or similar) Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, with the ability to break down complex challenges and think through solutions clearly Available to work in a hybrid model in São Paulo or Rio de Janeiro

positions.name: [Banco de Talentos] Forward Deployed AI Scientist Intern, Brazil - BCG X
positions.posting_name: [Banco de Talentos] Forward Deployed AI Scientist Intern, Brazil - BCG X
positions.job_description: We are looking for profiles with a background in any area related to predictive analytics, machine learning, optimization/operations as well as risk. Please note that this opportunity is currently a talent pool. The selection process is expected to begin in the first semester of 2027, for a start date in August 2027. Bachelor's degree with excellent academic achievements in a field linked to computer science, applied mathematics, statistics, machine learning, or related data centric areas - Expected graduation between Dec/2027 and Jun/2029. Experience/Knowledge in core analytics methods (e.g. Machine Learning, Optimization, Deep Learning, etc.) Proficiency in Python Excellent analytical skills and strategic thinking, creative problem solver Strong interpersonal credibility, reliability, and service mentality, high ethical standards Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws. Click here  for more information on E-Verify.

positions.name: Consulting Intern, Italy
positions.job_description: You will be a fundamental part of the team and work alongside some of the world's top minds in the industry, significantly contributing to the development of diverse topics and support our ambitious growth targets. In this context, you will work hand in hand with C-levels and key decision makers of our clients, while playing a critical role in the firm's project teams, contributing to the analysis, design, and implementation of business strategies for clients across various industries. You will: Be part of a team partnering with leading clients to provide solutions to business-critical challenges Contribute to the day-to-day execution of consulting projects, ensuring the successful delivery of client requirements within the scope of the engagement Perform qualitative and quantitative analysis for the project execution Work across a range of industries and functions We're looking for exceptional talent to join us. Enrolled in Master of Science or Master's degree At least 3 months work experience in structured context Strong academic track record Strong logical and analytical skills with outstanding number mindset, with a proactive and creative attitude Effective in working in a team Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Italian and English Advanced knowledge of MS Office suite (Excel and PowerPoint at excellent level) Familiarity with GenAI tools
